subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram pinned-message reads, and should the first version be an explicit gated on-demand action/command or automatic session context?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how persistent Telegram chat content is authorized, surfaced to agents, and optionally injected into session context.

options.title: On-demand gated action first
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list-pins or read-pinned action backed by getChat.pinned_message, behind an explicit action/config gate and without automatic session injection.

options.title: Fold into Telegram read design
options.body: Track pinned-message reads under the broader Telegram message-read work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12756 and settle retained-history semantics first.

options.title: Defer automatic context
options.body: Keep pinned-message reads out of runtime context until maintainers approve opt-in session-start injection and storage policy.

recommendation.title: On-demand gated action first
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list-pins or read-pinned action backed by getChat.pinned_message, behind an explicit action/config gate and without automatic session injection.

likelyOwner.reason: They already supplied the detailed prior review on this exact issue and have the strongest recent Telegram action/docs routing signal.
